Fanvue's average pricing advice

The August guide describes this as best-performing on average. It supplies no AI-only sample, cohort dates, weighting, or median.

Pricing guide · 10 Aug 2026
Cash timing
7–28 days

Pending balance window

The standard pending period is seven days and can extend to 28. Fanvue aims to initiate valid withdrawals within ten business days.

Earnings policy · 22 Apr 2026

The subscription is one revenue line.

Fanvue reports approximately 10% of first-two-month creator earnings from subscriptions and 60% from paid messages. It also reports about four in ten subscriptions surviving the first cycle and one in four lasting at least 90 days. These are platform-reported aggregates with an undisclosed sample, not an AI benchmark or forecast.

Inference: measure paid-message purchases and cohort renewal alongside subscription conversion. Never turn those survival figures into a constant monthly churn assumption.

Fanvue pricing & retention guide

PPV is a separate one-off purchase. The guide suggests a $10–$15 floor for the cheapest item; this is advice, not an enforced minimum. Describe the actual included content accurately.

PPV guide · 10 Aug 2026

Distribution and product need compatible rules.

Fanvue requires prominent AI disclosure, visually adult personas, and identity/consent verification for real people used in generated media. Its public profile assets must suit a general audience. The human operator still completes ID and selfie verification.

Community guidelines · 14 Jun 2026AI creator KYC

TikTok requires labels on realistic AI content and says a compliant AI label itself does not reduce distribution. Meta also labels generated media. Instagram's teen-account controls limit sexually suggestive material; an apparent total audience is not the same as reachable adult demand.

TikTok AI supportMeta AI labelsInstagram teen accounts · 2026

Inference: begin public discovery with nonexplicit fashion, lifestyle and story content, using clear AI disclosure and adult audience measurement. A link hub does not change a destination's policy status.

Payout-method costs are additional: Fanvue lists a 1% TripleA payout fee; other third-party or currency-conversion costs can still exist. Payout fees. Paid delivery and creator payments must remain on Fanvue. Creator terms.

04 / Interactive unit economics

A million views can still lose money.

This is a hypothetical new-payer cohort model. Every input is an assumption you can change. None of these conversion rates or revenue results was observed for a listed creator.

Match all funnel denominators to one measurement window. “Fanvue arrival” means attributed traffic, “payer” means an actual first payment, and free follows are a separate measure. Returning subscribers are excluded.

Set the assumptions

Payers = impressions × profile-visit yield × Fanvue-arrival yield × paid conversion

Gross/payer = first subscription + PPV buyer share × purchases/buyer × PPV price + average tips

The 80% standard share is a platform fact. Costs below are assumed; include production, tools, labor and acquisition. Adjustments are absolute dollars deducted after the platform share. Real accounting can require further processing, tax and currency items.

05 / Original creative direction

One persona. A world worth returning to.

An original proposal for validation, not an observed winner or a recreation of any reference creator.

FashionTravelDaily storyClearly AI

Design for recognition, then test demand.

Create an original, clearly adult Asian fictional character with stable facial identity, adult proportions, a consistent color palette and a recurring daily narrative. A nominal age cannot substitute for visually adult appearance. Public assets should remain suitable for broad discovery.

Adult appearance, disclosure & public assets
Recognition cuesChoose one hairstyle, one signature accessory and a muted jade / warm cream palette. Maintain those cues across outfits and scenes.
Content pillarsFashion styling, city travel, matcha ritual, and diary-like story arcs. Test each pillar with comparable creative effort.
Clear identityBio: “Fictional adult AI character, 25. Fashion, travel & daily stories.” Use platform disclosure tools on realistic generated media.
Subscription valueState exactly what the monthly tier includes. Test a distinct premium collection rather than an ambiguous promise.
Quality gateReject identity drift, anatomical defects, incoherent text and mismatched lighting. Record rejected outputs and editing time.
Human operationThe operator completes KYC. Never copy a real face or body without the required documented consent and verification.

Creative recommendations above are analyst proposals, not evidence of proven conversion. Public biographies show differentiated positioning in the audited account cards; the proposal uses that general principle without copying identities.

06 / Proposed experiment

Thirty days to replace guesses.

A time-boxed validation plan with measurement gates. Targets are operating choices, not creator benchmarks.

DAYS 01–07

Identity & instrumentation

  • Build an original adult persona bible and asset quality checklist.
  • Complete Fanvue operator KYC and prominent AI disclosure.
  • Set up attributed links and daily reach / visit / arrival logs.
  • Define subscription inclusions and document tools, labor and budget.
DAYS 08–14

Creative discovery

  • Test fashion, travel, ritual and character-story posts.
  • Compare profile-visit yield using matching date windows.
  • Monitor recommendation eligibility and adult audience data where available.
  • Retain effective concepts; record generated-asset rejection rates.
DAYS 15–21

First payment & value

  • Separate free follows, trials and collected first subscriptions.
  • Calculate paid conversion from attributed arrivals.
  • Test clearly described subscription value and one distinct PPV bundle.
  • Record realized price, buyer rate, purchases, tips and refunds.
DAYS 22–30

Contribution & cohorts

  • Reconcile gross, platform share, adjustments and actual costs.
  • Compare variants by contribution per hour of operator labor.
  • Follow first-cycle renewal cohorts as they become observable.
  • Scale only from positive measured economics and compliant distribution.
Decision gate: a visually strong feed and a large following do not pass validation. Require measured paying demand and positive contribution after recorded costs; if the data are too sparse, continue the experiment without claiming a proven business.

07 / Confidence and limitations

Three independent questions per account.

Triple checking means testing identity, audience and paid destination separately. It does not mean calling three copies of the same data three independent sources.

01 · Who is this?

Match the exact handle, creator-owned hub and reciprocal links where available. Prefer primary biographies for Asian persona positioning and AI/hybrid status. A namesake or a similar face is not an identity join.

02 · What reach is observed?

Inspect a dated provider response containing a real social-profile object. Label current counts, historical screenshots, secondary list counts and unavailable data separately. A wrapper's success field is insufficient if the nested profile failed.

03 · Where is the paid product?

Inspect the direct public Fanvue profile and its available primary metadata. Yuna required a rendered fetch; her exact likes, AI flag and price remain unresolved. An AI flag or an open page does not reveal paid customers, actual transactions, profit, or an active social-to-Fanvue funnel.

“Current” means observed on the stated research date through the specified public source or provider, not guaranteed real-time availability. Failed access is not proof of a ban or deletion. Synthetic persona ethnicity or location does not establish the human operator's ethnicity or residence.
Evidence grades and metric definitions

Strong identity chain: a primary social biography or creator-owned hub explicitly joins the exact social and Fanvue destinations; reciprocal links strengthen it. Partial chain: corroborating branding or direct profile exists, but the full outbound join is missing. Current audience evidence: a dated successfully resolved social profile with an observed count. Dated / secondary: a crawl, third-party listing or old screenshot that must not be presented as a live count.

Fanvue agg_like_count is an aggregate action count. It is neither unique followers nor paid subscribers. Raw standard-price fields are archived without inferring their currency. The report displays the localized VND price shown publicly; promotional and checkout amounts can differ. Audience size does not establish authenticity, adult reachable audience, revenue or profit.
